Welcome to saber ! How may I help you?

International Innovation University was established under the Cabinet of Ministers' State Inspectorate of Education Quality Control, with license No. 222829 issued on July 29, 2022. It offers undergraduate programs in various fields such as Economy, Accounting & Auditing, Finance & Financial Technologies, and more. The university also provides Master's programs in Economy and Linguistics. Currently, there are over 1,000 full-time and 3,200 part-time students enrolled, with modern classrooms, a world-class library, and on-campus facilities including dormitories and kitchens. The faculty consists of more than 86 professors and teachers with scientific degrees, and the university collaborates with production enterprises and banks to enhance practical learning.
